title.en: The One About the Hidden Call

description.es: Fina visita a Marta en el despacho decidida a confrontarla sobre la llamada de Bianca. Marta admite haberla ocultado, lo que provoca la decepción de Fina, incapaz de comprender sus motivos. Entre reproches, Marta confiesa su miedo a perderla si revive el cariño hacia Bianca. Abrumada por la inseguridad de Marta y la tensión de la conversación, Fina se marcha del despacho, dejando la relación en un punto crítico.
description.en: Fina visits Marta at the office, determined to confront her about Bianca's call. Marta admits she hid it, which leaves Fina disappointed, unable to understand her reasons. Amid reproaches, Marta confesses her fear of losing her if the affection for Bianca is rekindled. Overwhelmed by Marta's insecurity and the tension of the conversation, Fina leaves the office, leaving the relationship at a critical point.
